newsitem.title: POLAND: GM stake in Polish bank could reach 79 pct.
newsitem.headline: GM stake in Polish bank could reach 79 pct.

text.p: The small Polish bank Polbank SA will offer its new, 2.5 million share issue to General Motors Acceptance Corporation (GMAC) which would raise GMAC's stake in the bank to 79 percent, the bank's legal officer said.
"If GMAC takes over the whole issue it will have 79 percent of shares giving it 64.6 percent of votes," Piotr Pilzak told Reuters.
Pilzak said GMAC, a subsidiary of the General Motors group, currently had 68 percent of Polbank, or 52 percent of votes.
He said the issue would raise the bank's capital to 14.6 million zlotys from 9.6 million zlotys. The capital is currently divided into 4,801,200 shares.
